topic: Write an argumentative essay about the value of space exploration(写一篇关于太空探索价值的议论文)
title_en: Is Space Exploration Worth the Cost?
genre: 议论文 / 说明文(argue why we explore space + give reasons)
source: 人教版2019必修三 Unit 4 Reading for Writing:present an argument about the value of space exploration(为太空探索的价值表明观点并给出理由)。
prompt_cn: 假设你叫李华,学校英语报正在征稿,主题是'太空探索值得吗?'。请用英语写一篇约100词的议论文,内容包括:① 提出你的观点(太空探索值得/不值得);② 给出两到三条理由(如卫星帮助农业、推动科技、寻找新家园);③ 在结尾重申你的观点。注意:用不定式表目的(to do / in order to / so as to)等结构。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Li Hua. Your school's English newspaper is collecting articles on the topic 'Is space exploration worth it?'. Write an argumentative essay (about 100 words) that: 1) states your opinion (space exploration is / is not worth it); 2) gives two or three reasons (e.g. satellites help farming, space research drives technology, the search for a new home); 3) restates your opinion at the end. Try to use to-infinitives of purpose (to do / in order to / so as to).
points: 提出观点(In my opinion, exploring space is well worth it.)
理由一·卫星与农业(Satellites collect data so as to help farmers grow more food.)
理由二·科技进步(Space research drives technology to improve daily life.)
结尾重申观点(For these reasons, I firmly believe space exploration is worthwhile.)
model_essay: Countries around the globe spend billions on space missions, and some people think this is a waste. In my opinion, however, exploring space is well worth it. Firstly, satellites circle the Earth to collect data on weather and land, which helps farmers grow more food. Secondly, space research drives technology forward; many useful products, from heart monitors to smartphone cameras, were first made for space. Finally, scientists explore other planets so as to find a possible new home, because our resources are limited. For these reasons, I firmly believe that space exploration is not a waste, but a wise investment in our future.
model_translation: 全球各国在太空任务上投入数十亿,有些人认为这是浪费。然而在我看来,探索太空非常值得。首先,卫星绕地球运行以收集天气和陆地的数据,帮助农民种出更多粮食。其次,太空研究推动科技进步;从心脏监测仪到智能手机摄像头,许多有用的产品最初都是为太空研制的。最后,科学家探索其他星球,是为了寻找一个可能的新家园,因为我们的资源是有限的。基于这些理由,我坚信太空探索不是浪费,而是对我们未来的明智投资。

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:亮明观点 / 两三条理由 / 结尾重申观点
总—分—总清晰、Firstly/Secondly/Finally 衔接、首尾呼应
句型词汇准确多样、不定式表目的等运用得当、语法基本无误

required_structure: 亮明观点 In my opinion, exploring space is well worth it.
理由1 Satellites collect data … which helps farmers grow more food.
理由2 Space research drives technology to improve daily life.
理由3 + 结尾 Scientists explore other planets so as to find a new home. For these reasons, I firmly believe …
key_expressions: In my opinion, exploring space is well worth it.
Satellites circle the Earth to collect data on weather and land.
Many useful products were first made for space.
Scientists explore other planets so as to find a possible new home.

high_sentences: In my opinion, exploring space is well worth it.
Satellites circle the Earth to collect data so as to help farmers grow more food.
Many useful products, from heart monitors to smartphone cameras, were first made for space.
Scientists explore other planets to find a possible new home, because our resources are limited.

error_pairs.wrong: We explore space for find a new home.
error_pairs.correct: We explore space to find a new home.
error_pairs.note: 表目的用不定式 to do,不用 for + do。

error_pairs.wrong: Satellites are sent up for collecting data.
error_pairs.correct: Satellites are sent up to collect data.
error_pairs.note: 表目的更自然用 to do;for doing 表用途、口气不同。

error_pairs.wrong: It is worth to explore space.
error_pairs.note: be worth + doing 是固定结构,不接 to do。

paragraph_template:
【太空探索议论文结构】
开头:摆现象 + 亮明观点 In my opinion, exploring space is well worth it.
主体:Firstly … 卫星帮农业;Secondly … 推动科技;Finally … 寻找新家园(用 to do / so as to 表目的)
结尾:For these reasons, I firmly believe space exploration is worthwhile.
